supersedesProposal.Reason: Two manual pinned-code role refinements; first proposal retained unchanged.

method: Read pinned Python files as UTF8 text only; lexical def/import/call-facet anchors, exact SHA peers, bounded literal-reference search. No Python parser or execution; no .NET CLI.
limits: Lexical patterns may match comments or generated-code strings and are not an AST or callgraph.
No caller activation, per-file parity, retirement, scope exclusion or deletion is approved.
Exact-SHA peers establish byte identity only; historical profile/caller obligations remain.
Source worker alone writes the authoritative union inventory. Original files and old snapshots remain retained.

requirementDecisionProposals.snapshot-profile: Confirm historical/profile context and consolidate unique assertions with the canonical owner. Exact byte identity can reuse analysis, not grant profile parity. Explicitly retire only obsolete duplicate executable-wrapper requirements; retain original evidence.
requirementDecisionProposals.historical-review: Consider retiring this round-specific wrapper requirement after the single native review workflow preserves its required continuation, isolation, full receipts and audit semantics. Preserve historical inputs; no review launch or pre-ready HV is authorized.
requirementDecisionProposals.publication-operations: Reconcile old manual copy/ledger/packaging duties with native Publish Check/Stage and recipe services. Retire a one-time operational wrapper only by explicit requirement decision; do not infer full native parity.
requirementDecisionProposals.one-time-mutation: Decide whether this historical edit remains a regeneration requirement. If obsolete, explicitly retire executing this exact patch script, keeping the resulting declarative source and original provenance. If still required, allocate its exact behavior to one native generator and tests.
requirementDecisionProposals.diagnostic-consolidation: Confirm whether this audit is still required. Preserve its assertions and input profile in the shared native validation workflow before retiring a duplicate one-off command. A saved verdict alone is not an equivalent validator.
requirementDecisionProposals.test-parity: Retain exact original assertions/profile and allocate same-case native coverage before retiring this test runner. No source deletion or acceptance follows from role assignment.
requirementDecisionProposals.producer-parity: Keep the requirement open: assign exact functions, errors, side effects, inputs and callers to a native category operation. No retirement suggested without a separate explicit requirement change.
requirementDecisionProposals.decision-open: Root must resolve the exact caller/recipe activation and responsibility. This supplement makes no retirement, scope exclusion or completion decision.
